markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (57%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged low-reliability simulated frozen section (JPEG severity 3) [F6], with Normal (42%) close behind [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 57%, Normal 42%, Benign 1%, Invasive 0% | Split between InSitu and Normal |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% coverage target | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability (flagged); 100% OOD | Suspect input; extreme out-of-distribution image |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match InSitu (all Normal) [F5] | Nearest references are all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 6, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-1.296 contribution), failed AI spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 10) · context · Below-typical (+0.393 contribution); descriptive only (8/20 check) [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (+0.362 contribution) favoring invasion (19/20 check) [F4] · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random (0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- JPEG-degraded frozen section (100% OOD) distorts Normal tissue (42% probability; all 5 neighbors Normal).
- Poor quality masks focal invasion in regions 5, 8, or 9; recut and deeper levels drafted.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: Highest heatmap risk (94%, 95%); verify in situ vs normal epithelium.
2. **Region 5**: Highest validated stromal invasion score; exclude focal invasion before recut or deeper levels.
3. **Regions 1, 2, 9**: Superior (83%) and inferior (65%) margin hotspots; margin call deferred [F7].
